main_text.p: Peppis enim & tonsoribus notum, in ore, quod pari cum ventriculo & intestinis membrana vestitur, usu postulante, haud cohibendam excitari per Spiritum vitrio- levi contactu ἰχάρ. Hęc scribere non dubescit. Ast tantum abest, ut Sylvius statuat omnem effervescentiam esse neam, ut ex professo doceat, nullam æter blandā effervescentiā in benè institutō humano corpore excitari: potę qui suæ praxeos p. 106. Non tantum, ait, quando è ventriculo ad Inte- stina propelluntur alimenta fermentata, fluunt quoque in tenue intestinum Bilis Succus Pancreaticus; verum continuo, F adeo-

page.notes: Transcription is partly uncertain at the left edge, where letters are cut off by the scan; some Greek words (ἰχάρ, κατπ-) are approximate. Lines at left margin are truncated and marked as printed fragments.
